items.html: *The matter of the Klipot, and the matter of the four worlds ABYA, and the difference among them. Know that also in the Klipot there are aspects of ABYA, and in each world there are five Partzufim, which are the summary of the ten Sefirot of that world, and each Partzuf of them includes ten Sefirot, in the same manner as it is in holiness.
